summary: This document details the implementation of a Reminder functionality within the HSPnet system. The Reminder allows users to schedule, send, and manage email reminders with specific dates, priorities, and messages.
purpose: The main purpose of the Reminder system is to enable users to send scheduled email reminders with customizable content and settings.

fields.name: txtSendOn
fields.description: Input field for the date to send the reminder.

fields.name: txtEmailSubject
fields.description: Input field for the subject of the email reminder.

fields.name: txtEmailBody
fields.description: Input field for the body of the email reminder.

fields.name: rblPriority
fields.description: Selector for the priority of the reminder.

workflows.name: Schedule a Reminder
steps: User enters email subject and message.
User can choose to share the reminder.

business_rules: Reminders can only be scheduled for tomorrow or later.
validations: Send On date must be a valid date format.
Send On date cannot be in the past.
conditions: If the user is in edit mode, fields are populated with existing reminder data.
system_behavior: The system disables editing controls if the reminder is not editable by the user.
exceptions: If Send On date is invalid or in the past, an error message is displayed.
